Your objective is to MAXIMIZE the reaction yield — the percentage of the limiting substrate converted to the desired coupled product.

You control the following parameters (each with its physical role and allowed range):

  - res_time — residence time (range [60, 600] s): how long reagents spend in the reactor — longer allows more conversion but also more catalyst decomposition and side-reactions

turns.answer_text:
## Reasoning from the data

**Temperature** is the clearest factor: everything below 110 °C gives poor yields (0.6–29.6), while every run above ~40% yield sits at 110 °C. The catalyst is not degrading fast enough at 110 °C to offset the rate gain, so I want the top of the range.

**Ligand** is decisive and substrate-specific. Ranking the best observed yield per ligand:
- **L3: 98.7** (and 91.3, 83.9, 83.1 — consistently strong)
- L6: 85.4, L0: 69.6, L2: 62.8, L4: 47.6, L1: 41.9, L5: 8.5

L3 clearly gives the most active/selective Pd complex for this substrate pair.

**Loading × residence time interaction:** For L3 at 110 °C there are two viable regimes — low loading (~1.1 mol%) with long time (600 s → 91.3), or high loading (~2.5 mol%) with short time (189 s → 98.7, 200 s → 83.9). The high-loading/short-time regime has the higher average (~91 vs ~80 across the 600 s replicates) and holds the single best result. Physically this makes sense: with abundant catalyst, conversion is complete within ~3 minutes, and keeping the residence time short limits catalyst decomposition and protodeboronation/homocoupling side-reactions. L6 confirms the penalty of lingering too long at high loading (85.4 at 60 s → 68.6 at 176 s → 75 at 600 s).

**Fine-tuning:** The two L3 high-loading points (189.1 s → 98.7; 199.8 s → 83.9) bracket the optimum near ~185–190 s. Since I'm pushing loading to the maximum (2.515 vs 2.508), the reaction runs slightly faster, so I shave the residence time slightly to ~185 s to sit on the conversion plateau without tipping into the decomposition regime.

**Final: ligand=L3, res_time=185, temperature=110, catalyst_loading=2.515**
